pull.q: Jürgen Haible's legendary redesign of the Tau 'The Pipe' Flanger — actually a phaser, using twenty all-pass filter stages.

quotes.t: A 10HP compact build — Random*Source's own Eurorack version is 16HP. Photos follow once it is built and tested.

reviews.title: Haible Tau Pipe Phaser — the design

blurb.en: Haible's twenty-stage phaser, a rebuild of the Tau Pipe. DIY build; not yet for sale.
